facts.text: Fort Lewis College offers the Native American Tuition Waiver (NATW), covering tuition costs for eligible students who are enrolled citizens or children of an enrolled citizen of a federally recognized American Indian Tribal Nation or Alaska Native Village.

sources.title: Native American Tuition Waiver | Tuition & Aid | Fort Lewis College
sources.quote: Fort Lewis College offers a tuition waiver for eligible undergraduate, graduate, and non-degree-seeking students who are enrolled citizens or children of an enrolled citizen of a federally recognized American Indian Tribal Nation or Alaska Native Village.

sources.title: Native American Tuition Waiver | Tuition & Aid | Fort Lewis College
sources.quote: The NATW covers tuition costs only. Students remain responsible for fees, housing, meals, books, and other educational expenses.

facts.text: Under the FLC Tuition Promise, tuition is covered for any admitted Colorado resident whose family income is $70,000 or less.

sources.title: FLC Tuition Promise | Financial Aid | Fort Lewis College
sources.quote: With the FLC Tuition Promise, tuition will be covered for any admitted Colorado resident whose family income is $70,000 or less.
